say:0:1910629101:1.text: The Graveborn you pursue is, in all likelihood, someone trying to resurrect the Mother Goddess or call her home.
say:0:1910629101:1.source_cn: 你们所追逐的亡灵，极有可能是试图复活或寻回母神的人。
say:0:1910629101:1.male: The Graveborn you pursue is, in all likelihood, someone trying to resurrect the Mother Goddess or call her home.
say:0:1910629101:1.female: The Graveborn you pursue is, in all likelihood, someone trying to resurrect the Mother Goddess or call her home.

say:1:1910629102:1.text: The Graveborn inscribed his wish in an age older than the records of the Deepfolk who are alive now. That means some Shallowfolk once knew of the Mother Goddess as well, but the Shallowfolk of today have lost their faith and forgotten.
say:1:1910629102:1.source_cn: 亡灵刻下心愿的时代比现存深海裔族群的记录还要古老，说明...
say:1:1910629102:1.male: The Graveborn inscribed his wish in an age older than the records of the Deepfolk who are alive now. That means some Shallowfolk once knew of the Mother Goddess as well, but the Shallowfolk of today have lost their faith and forgotten.
